messages:
jules: Quick report: after last night's policy push we saw a tiny but consistent uptick in hedged calls. p95 +22ms. Suspect mismatched decision snapshots between routers.
vikram: saw that too. logs show decision_epoch_local=8821 vs incoming_epoch=8822 then route:forked=true.
carmen: ops-impact: increased hedges -> ~1.7% more downstream GPU load. Not ideal.
jules: brainstorm: attach epoch on inbound requests (X-Decision-Epoch) so routers can detect mismatch and apply a small bounded wait or explicit fallback.
vikram: tradeoffs: waiting buys consistency but costs latency and capacity; immediate fallback increases semantic drift across replicas. We need policy-level knob.
carmen: propose three-mode flag per-tenant: allow|prefer|strict. default prefer. prefer: wait up to 8ms for same-epoch route, then fallback. strict: wait up to 25ms & require quorum of routers. allow: immediate.
jules: probe behavior: our synthetic probes are noisy during transitions. Idea: tag probes with origin_epoch and ignore probe-triggered hedges if origin_epoch < local_epoch -1.
ops-bot: "policy-service deployed snapshot=8823 at 2026-03-26T02:10:05Z"
vikram: next steps: small sim with mixed-epoch traffic, staging enable prefer, add metrics routing.epoch_mismatch_count + epoch_wait_ms, then 1% canary strict. I'll draft RFC addendum.
carmen: i'll add dashboard tiles and an alert: hedged_rate > baseline +1% -> page oncall."
